Chief complaint: abscess on chest.

Denies any fever or chills. no headache or dizziness. Denies any chest pain, SOb. no nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. no change in products. no recent bug or tick bites. Mole on head that he wants checked Not sure how long he's had it. Cut hair off and now visible. Waiting for Endocrine appt. Taking Naltrexone low dose for eye related nerve pain from Ophtho. Has a right sided headache.

Chief complaint: discuss labs.
Here today to discuss labs. Had labs done with function health. Had thyroglobulin antibody of 174. TPO 7. TSH 2.17, T3 3.4, T4 1.2. Has some cold intolerance. Feels like hands feel like ice. Has noticed shivering when hot. no heat intolerance. no fatigue. no constipation. no hair loss. no unexplained weight gain or loss. Dry skin at times. no joint pain or muscle aches. no rashes. no family history of thyroid issues. Denies any fever or chills. no dizziness. Headache but has not changed or worsened. Denies any chest pain, SOB. n o nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. normal bowel movements or urination. no blood in urine. no blood in stool or black stools.

Chief complaint: left knee pain.
Here today with complaints of left knee pain. Was doing lateral step ups yesterday and started with pain. Did not hear or feel any popping. Aching pain. Throbbing pain. Hard to bear weight. no swelling, redness, or bruising. Numbness and tinging. RAdiates down shin. Denies any fever or chills. no headache or dizziness. no nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. no chest pain ,SOB. Worsens with walking. Tried ice and compression for symptoms.

Chief complaint: eye lid redness, flaking, and dry skin.
Here today for redness and flaking to both eyes. Previously treated for conjunctivitis 2 weeks ago. Drainage from eyes improved. Flaking, redness around eye lids. no itching. no further drainage. Denies any fever or chills. no vision changes. no headache or dizziness. Denies any runny nose, sore throat, or cough. Denies any chest pain, SOB. no nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. no change in products. Tried eye drops and lotion for symptoms.

Chief complaint: possible pink eye.
Here today with possible pink eye. Started 2 weeks ago. In both eyes. no vision changes. Redness. Crusting in morning. Drainage and discharge. no itching. no gritty feeling. Denies any fever or chills. no injury or trauma. no contact use. Denies any headache or dizziness. Denies any runny nose, sore throat, or cough.
